target.statement: EmpHi achieves a BLEU recall of 0.4723 on the EmpatheticDialogues test set, outperforming MIME (0.3278) and other baselines.

compute.basis: Training a small GRU-based CVAE (11M params) on 25k dialogues for ~10 epochs on CPU is feasible but slow; with GPU it would be faster, but not strictly required.

blockers: Code repository may be incomplete or not maintained
Requires training a BERT intent classifier on EmpatheticIntents dataset (additional step)
No pre-trained model provided, so training from scratch is necessary
title: EmpHi: Generating Empathetic Responses with Human-like Intents
